main_body: A snow-roofed stone well. The main volume is the stone well body with a dark water opening, under a snow-covered roof held up by two wooden posts.
top_band: Pale grey-white stone rim around the opening at rows ~16-17, with the dark teal ellipse of the opening below it at rows ~17-22. The snow roof above is a separate light band at rows ~1-8.
evidence: Reading down the middle column: the snow roof, then the stone rim, then the dark ellipse opening with a wooden bucket and water seen from above. A lighter rim row at ~22 marks the front edge, and the stone front face with dark course bands runs from row ~23 to 30. The opening is a real ellipse you can see into, not a line, so both a horizontal surface and a front face are drawn. The front stone courses are only painted bands, not recessed.

style.evidence: The snow roof has about 4-5 steps (white, pale blue, blue-grey, shadow) with icicles and wood-brown ends. The posts carry two or three browns, and the outlines lean brown or blue-grey rather than black. The stone base is thinner than the reference: grey courses split by flat dark bands with little per-stone speckle. It is slightly less rich than the roofed-well reference but not sticker-like.
